4 /-!
5 The complete pyramid case: keep the original polygonal base whole and unfold
6 every triangular side outward along its original base edge.
7 -/
8 
9 namespace SixVertexUnfolding
10 
11 /-- Every convex pyramid, with any number of base vertices, has an original-edge unfolding. -/
12 theorem every_convex_pyramid_has_edge_unfolding (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (p : P.Pyramid) :
13     P.HasEdgeUnfolding := by
14   classical
15   obtain ⟨left, left_rigid⟩ := p.base.exists_rigid_placement
16   have placements (F : P.Face) : ∃ right : Space →ᵃ[ℝ] Plane,
17       (∀ x ∈ F.val, ∀ y ∈ F.val, dist (right x) (right y) = dist x y) ∧
18       (∀ x : P.Vertex, (x : Space) ∈ F.val → (x : Space) ∈ p.base.val → right x = left x) ∧
19       (F = p.base → right = left) ∧
20       (F ≠ p.base → Disjoint (interior (left '' p.base.val)) (interior (right '' F.val)) ∧
21         ∀ x : P.Vertex, (x : Space) ∈ p.base.val → (x : Space) ∉ F.val →
22           dist (x : Space) p.apex < dist (left x) (right p.apex)) := by
23     by_cases is_base : F = p.base
24     · subst F
25       exact ⟨left, left_rigid, fun _ _ _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl,
26         fun impossible => False.elim (impossible rfl)⟩
27     · obtain ⟨right, rigid, joined, safe, farther⟩ := p.exists_petal F is_base left left_rigid
28       exact ⟨right, rigid, joined, fun equal => False.elim (is_base equal), fun _ => ⟨safe, farther⟩⟩
29   choose copy rigid joined fixed_base petals using placements
30   have base_copy : copy p.base = left := fixed_base p.base rfl
31   apply p.unfolding_of_copies copy rigid
32   · intro F x xF xB
33     rw [base_copy]
34     exact joined F x xF xB
35   · intro F side
36     rw [base_copy]
37     exact (petals F side).1
38   · intro F side x xB xF
39     rw [base_copy]
40     exact (petals F side).2 x xB xF

42 /-- A facet containing all but one original vertex is a pyramid base. -/
43 theorem has_edge_unfolding_of_large_face (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (base : P.Face)
44     (one_missing : (base.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard + 1 = P.vertices.card) :
45     P.HasEdgeUnfolding := by
46   obtain ⟨v, vertex, outside⟩ := base.exists_vertex_outside
47   have base_vertices : base.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space) = (P.vertices : Set Space) \ {v} := by
48     apply Set.eq_of_subset_of_ncard_le
49     · rintro x ⟨xB, xP⟩
50       exact ⟨xP, fun same => outside (same ▸ xB)⟩
51     · rw [Set.ncard_diff_singleton_of_mem vertex, Set.ncard_coe_finset]
52       omega
53     · exact P.vertices.finite_toSet.diff
54   apply every_convex_pyramid_has_edge_unfolding P
55   refine {
56     base := base
57     apex := ⟨v, vertex⟩
58     apex_outside := outside
59     other_vertices := ?_
60   }
61   intro x different
62   have member : (x : Space) ∈ (P.vertices : Set Space) \ {v} :=
63     ⟨x.property, fun same => different (Subtype.ext same)⟩
64   rw [← base_vertices] at member
65   exact member.1
66 
67 /-- The five-vertex configuration with a quadrilateral facet is completely unfolded. -/
68 theorem every_five_vertex_polyhedron_with_quadrilateral_face (P : ConvexPolyhedron)
69     (five_vertices : P.vertices.card = 5) (base : P.Face)
70     (quadrilateral : (base.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4) :
71     P.HasEdgeUnfolding := by
72   apply has_edge_unfolding_of_large_face P base
73   omega
74 
75 /-- The six-vertex configuration with a pentagonal facet is completely unfolded. -/
76 theorem every_six_vertex_polyhedron_with_pentagonal_face (P : ConvexPolyhedron)
77     (six_vertices : P.vertices.card = 6) (base : P.Face)
78     (pentagon : (base.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 5) :
79     P.HasEdgeUnfolding := by
80   apply has_edge_unfolding_of_large_face P base
81   omega
82 
83 end SixVertexUnfolding
